People's Majlis Environment and Climate Change Committee
Agenda

Committee: People's Majlis Environment and Climate Change Committee
Meeting: 9th Meeting
Venue: Committee Room 6
Date: 5 August 2026 (Wednesday)
Time: 10:00

1. Discussion on how to proceed with the work on the Bill to amend Law No. 26/2020 (Utility Regulatory Authority Act)
- Setting the deadline for completing the review of the bill.
- Deciding on advertising to seek public opinion on the bill.
- Deciding on sending letters to seek comments from relevant agencies on the bill.

2. Review of the Bill to amend Law No. 24/2022 (Waste Management Act).
